title: Software Development Intern
shortDescription: Worked as part of an internal web and desktop app development team in the IT department at Steel Dynamics, Inc.
longDescription: As a Software Development Intern in the IT department at Steel Dynamics, Inc., I worked closely with an internal team focused on building robust web and desktop applications. One of my primary projects involved modernizing a legacy, data-driven PowerBuilder reporting tool for Microsoft Dynamics GP. By transitioning this general ledger tool into a streamlined Vue.js application, I significantly reduced the onboarding time required for new employees. Additionally, I designed and implemented an automated daily digest service that integrates with our IT ticketing software. This service automatically alerts management to new Data Definition Language (DDL) changes in our MS SQL databases, ultimately saving 6 to 18 hours per quarter that were previously spent manually linking database changes to approval tickets during audits.

title: Co-Founder
location: Terre Haute, Indiana, United States · Remote
shortDescription: Co-founder of a senior capstone LLC developing a proof-of-concept autonomous drone system powered by a proprietary UV light communication module.
longDescription: Co-founder of Fafnir Aerospace, an LLC originating as my senior capstone project at Rose-Hulman Institute of Technology. We are building a proof of concept demonstrating our proprietary UV light communication module integrated onto an autonomous drone for routing and object detection. In my role, I lead the development of the drone's routing algorithms and Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) architecture to enable full autonomy. We plan to continue operating and scaling the company beyond graduation.

title: Software Engineer Intern
shortDescription: Developed and maintained web applications using React and Node.js. Created internal documentation and participated in code reviews.
longDescription: As a Software Engineer Intern at Rose-Hulman Ventures, I was responsible for developing and maintaining web applications using React and Node.js. My role involved creating internal documentation to facilitate knowledge sharing among team members and participating in code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to best practices. I collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions that met client requirements.

title: Teaching Assistant
shortDescription: Assisted students in laboratory for Introduction to Systems Programming and graded for a multitude of other courses.
longDescription: In my role as a Teaching Assistant at Rose-Hulman Institute of Technology, I assisted students in the laboratory for an introductory systems programming course. My responsibilities included providing support to students in understanding complex programming concepts, debugging code, and guiding them through practical exercises. Additionally, I graded students' submissions for Introduction to Database Systems, Introduction to Web Development, and Theory of Computation.

title: Volunteer
shortDescription: Intalled and set-up workstation computers by intergrating them with existing network infrastructure. Assisted in website development and maintenance via Wix.
longDescription: As a Volunteer at Kid Kare Project, Inc., I was responsible for installing and setting up workstation computers, ensuring they were integrated with the existing network infrastructure. Additionally, I assisted in the development and maintenance of the organization's website using Wix, enhancing their online presence and functionality.
